fields.System.Title: Occlusion threshold
fields.System.Description: The Sensor Monitoring component shall detect downstream occlusion when pressure remains above 80 kPa, stop output and request a latched critical alarm. A bounded dwell filters transient spikes without hiding sustained occlusion.
fields.Microsoft.VSTS.CMMI.AcceptanceCriteria: With downstream pressure held above 80 kPa for 3 s, output is stopped and a critical alarm is latched at the 3 s boundary. Exactly 80 kPa does not trigger; invalid samples inhibit output.
